fact: The Ministry of Education's 2023/24 Malawi Education Statistics Report (EMIS bulletin) presents primary, secondary and tertiary statistics, such as 5,420,159 primary pupils in 2023/24, drawn from one administrative source, the Annual School Census returns of schools, with 2022/23 comparatives; one edition, covering 2023/24.
title: Malawi Education Statistics Report 2023/24
publisher: Ministry of Education, Education Management Information System
